meta.name: docs-updater
meta.description: Provides automated documentation updates by analyzing git changes between the current branch and the last release tag. Performs git diff analysis to identify modifications, then updates README.md, CHANGELOG.md following Keep a Changelog standard, and discovers documentation folders for contextual updates. Use when preparing a release, maintaining documentation sync, or before creating a pull request. Triggers on "update docs", "update changelog", "sync documentation", "update readme", "prepare release documentation".

copy.tagline: 自动根据代码变更更新文档和变更日志
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发布前都要手动更新文档和变更日志。
